about.title: About Our
about.description: At Gau Raksha Seva Sansthan, we believe that serving cows is serving humanity. Since our inception, we have been a sanctuary for abandoned, sick, and injured cows, providing them with a loving home, medical care, and dignity.
about.mission_desc: To protect and serve every stray cow, ensuring they live a life free from hunger, cruelty, and neglect through dedicated rescue operations.
about.vision_desc: A compassionate world where no cow goes hungry or homeless, and traditional values of cow protection are upheld with modern care.
about.journey_desc: Started in 2015 with just 2 rescued cows in a small shed, we have grown into a family of over 500+ cattle, supported by a dedicated team of veterinarians and volunteers. Our journey is a testament to the community's trust and support.
about.feature1_desc: Immediate ambulance service for injured street cows.
about.feature2_desc: Nutritious, chemical-free diet and hygienic shelters.
about.feature3_desc: Old and non-milking cows are cared for until their last breath.
about.quote: The greatness of a nation and its moral progress can be judged by the way its animals are treated.
about.section_desc_1: Founded in 1998, our sanctuary began with just two rescued calves in a small shed. Over two decades of unwavering devotion, it has blossomed into a 50-acre haven dedicated to the protection and care of these divine creatures.
about.section_desc_2: Every corner of our grounds tells a story of compassion. We provide a lifetime of medical care, nourishing feed, and a peaceful environment where every soul is respected.
about.section_desc_3: Our daily operations are a labor of love, beginning before dawn with personalized health checks and the distribution of fresh, organic fodder. From specialized geriatric care for our elders to playful paddocks for the youngsters, our dedicated team ensures every cow receives genuine affection and a dignified life.

hero.title: Our Sacred Mission
hero.description: Dedicated to the protection, preservation, and welfare of our mother cows through timeless Vedic wisdom and modern compassion.

story.title: Preserving the Heart of Bharat
story.desc_1: Founded in 1998, Sacred Gaushala began as a humble shelter for just three abandoned calves. Our founder, inspired by the deep spiritual significance of Gau Seva (service to cows), envisioned a sanctuary where every cow—regardless of age or health—could live with dignity.
story.desc_2: Today, we have grown into a 50-acre haven, fostering a community of caretakers, environmentalists, and spiritual seekers. We don't just provide shelter; we celebrate the divine presence that cows bring to our world.
story.quote: Serving the cow is serving the divine essence of the Earth.

pillars.title: Our Core Pillars
pillars.description: Our work is guided by three core principles that define our commitment to these sacred beings and our planet.

compassion.title: Compassion
compassion.desc: Providing a lifelong home with 24/7 medical care, personalized nutrition, and unconditional love for rescued and elderly cattle.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.desc: Promoting organic farming and zero-waste ecosystems by converting cow waste into natural fertilizers and clean energy.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Educating the youth and involving local volunteers in spiritual Seva, fostering a culture of empathy and responsibility.
